verdict: Zoho Desk: Choose Zoho Desk when helpdesk value and Zoho suite alignment matter — especially with free 3-agent or $7 Express entry. Scores use the customer-service editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Exceptional value — Express $7 and free 3 agents
Full helpdesk feature stack on Professional+
weaknesses: Enterprise polish below Zendesk at top tier
Omnichannel depth moderate vs Suite Pro
bestFor: Budget-conscious teams wanting helpdesk with $7 Express floor
notIdealFor: Buyers wanting premium enterprise UX (Zendesk Suite)
Teams allergic to multi-product Zoho suite navigation
tradeoffs: Per-agent seats vs ticket/conversation caps and AI outcome pricing
Omnichannel breadth vs SMB simplicity in shared inbox tools
Suite upsell complexity vs transparent published plan floors
ITSM depth vs lightweight live-chat or ecommerce helpdesk fit
recommendation: Choose Zoho Desk when helpdesk value and Zoho suite alignment matter — especially with free 3-agent or $7 Express entry. Compare Freshdesk for Freshworks parity, Help Scout for SMB inbox simplicity, and Zendesk Suite for enterprise omnichannel scale.
